title: TypedClaimCard
description: A structured scientific claim extracted from a source text. Every field is required. The schema is enforced by Pydantic at extraction time.

claim_kind.description: The type of scientific commitment this claim makes

commitment_direction.description: Whether the theory asserts or denies this claim

causal_direction.description: The causal arrow between subject and object

physical_scale.description: The physical scale at which this claim operates

measurability.description: Whether this claim is currently measurable

relation.description: The typed relation connecting subject and object. Must conform to the ontology.

source_sentence.description: The exact sentence in the source text from which this claim was extracted

provenance_hash.description: Content hash linking to the exact source location
